name: POSTIDENT
description:
Mit der POSTIDENT App können Sie sich bequem und einfach über Ihr Smartphone identifizieren.

Je nachdem, für welches unserer Partnerunternehmen Sie die Identifizierung durchführen, können Sie sich entweder per Videochat, mit der Online-Ausweisfunktion des Personalausweises und des elektronischen Aufenthaltstitels oder vollautomatisch über die Erstellung von Aufnahmen Ihres Ausweisdokuments und Ihres Profils identifizieren. Mit Ihrer Online-Ausweisfunktion oder der automatisierten Prüfung Ihres Ausweisdokuments können Sie sich jederzeit schnell und sicher identifizieren. Bei allen weiteren Identifizierungsverfahren erfolgt die Prüfung Ihrer Daten durch Call-Center-Mitarbeiter der Deutschen Post AG. Diese stehen Ihnen montags bis sonntags in der Zeit von 8 bis 22 Uhr zur Verfügung. Außerdem können Sie den POSTIDENT Coupon zur Identifizierung in Ihrer Filiale direkt über die POSTIDENT App abrufen und müssen diesen damit nicht mehr ausdrucken.

Die Identifizierungsverfahren sind rechtskonform, sicher und funktionieren in nur wenigen Schritten. Geben Sie einfach die Vorgangsnummer ein, die Sie entweder von unserem Partnerunternehmen oder von uns erhalten haben. Die App führt Sie anschließend durch den Vorgang. Bei POSTIDENT durch Videochat erklärt Ihnen zudem ein Mitarbeiter der Deutschen Post, wie das Verfahren im Detail funktioniert.

Die POSTIDENT App ist optimiert für iPads und iPhones mit iOS 17 oder höher.

name: Signal – Sicherer Messenger
description:
• Signal ist eine Messaging-App, bei der Datenschutz und Privatsphäre im Mittelpunkt stehen. Sie ist kostenlos und einfach zu benutzen, mit einer starken Ende-zu-Ende-Verschlüsselung, die deine Kommunikation absolut vertraulich macht.

• Versende kostenlos Text- und Sprachnachrichten, Fotos, Videos, GIFs und sonstige Dateien. Signal verwendet die Internetverbindung deines Mobiltelefons, sodass du Gebühren für SMS und MMS vermeiden kannst.

• Rufe deine Kontakte mit glasklaren verschlüsselten Sprach- und Videoanrufen an. Gruppenanrufe sind für bis zu 50 Personen möglich.

• Bleibe in Verbindung durch Gruppen-Chats mit bis zu 1.000 Personen. Lege fest, wer posten darf, und verwalte die Gruppenmitglieder mit Admin-Berechtigungseinstellungen.

• Teile Bild-, Text- und Videostorys, die nach 24 Stunden wieder verschwinden. Mit den Datenschutz-Einstellungen kannst du genau festlegen, wer jede Story sehen kann.

• Signal ist für deine Privatsphäre gemacht. Wir wissen nichts über dich oder mit wem du sprichst. Unser Open Source-Signal Protokoll bedeutet, dass wir deine Nachrichten nicht lesen und deine Anrufe nicht mithören können. Ebenso wenig wie alle anderen. Keine Hintertüren, keine Datensammlung, keine Kompromisse. 

• Signal ist unabhängig und nicht auf Gewinn ausgerichtet – eine andere Art von Technologie von einer anderen Art von Organisation. Als Non-Profit-Organisation werden wir durch deine Spenden unterstützt, nicht durch Werbekunden oder Investoren. 

• Für Support, Fragen oder weitere Informationen besuche bitte https://support.signal.org/

Um unseren Quellcode zu sehen, besuche https://github.com/signalapp 

Folge uns auf Twitter @signalapp und Instagram @signal_app

name: Grok

Grok-Sprachmodus

Echtzeit-Informationen von X
Erhalte die aktuellsten Antworten. Mit direktem Zugriff auf X und das Web hält dich dieser KI-Assistent über die neuesten Nachrichten, Trends und Gespräche auf dem Laufenden. Lass Grok erweiterte Suchen auf X durchführen und erfahre, was die Leute wirklich sagen.

Schülerinnen und Studenten nutzen Grok zum Lernen und für klare Erklärungen. Berufstätige verlassen sich darauf für Recherche, Schreiben, Analyse und Problemlösung. Content-Creators erzeugen in Sekunden individuelle Bilder und Videos. Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler erhalten starke Hilfe beim Programmieren und technische Einblicke. Jeder, der einen schnellen, wahrheitsgetreuen und kreativen KI-Assistenten möchte, profitiert von Grok.

Für wen ist Grok?
Grok ist für neugierige Menschen gebaut, die mehr wollen als Standardantworten. Es eignet sich perfekt für Studierende, Berufstätige, Creators, Forschende und alle, die eine starke KI-Chat-Erfahrung mit fortschrittlichen Bild-, Video- und Agentenfunktionen suchen. Wenn dir Wahrheitssuche, Kreativität und Wissen in Echtzeit wichtig sind, ist Grok für dich gemacht.

Mit Grok als persönlichem KI-Assistenten werden das Navigieren durch Wissen, das Entfachen von Kreativität und das Erledigen echter Arbeit schneller und spannender. Lade Grok noch heute herunter und erlebe, was eine wirklich hilfreiche KI leisten kann.

Was Sie auf X tun können:

Warum X?
In einer Welt des ständigen Wandels ist X Ihre Echtzeit-Quelle, um voraus zu sein, mit Menschen in Kontakt zu treten und vielfältige Perspektiven zu erkunden. Von Live-Eilmeldungen und Trending-Memes bis hin zu Top-Podcasts und Live-Streams Ihrer Lieblings-Creator bringt X alles in einer leistungsstarken Social-Erfahrung zusammen.

name: IHK.AEVO Trainieren – Testen
summary: Train and test your AEVO-knowledge for the "training of trainers".
description:
With over 500 tasks, you can easily check your knowledge of the “training of trainers” according to the Trainer Suitability Ordinance (AEVO). 

This is what the app offers:

- Expand your knowledge with the help of the flashcards: The tasks are displayed directly to you with the correct answers.
- Test your knowledge with interactive tasks: choose the correct solution from several answer options and compare the correct solutions with your own answers. Get an overview of your current level of knowledge.
- Learn in a targeted manner by selecting fields of action or putting together tasks across fields of activity.
- Deepen your knowledge with the help of 400 glossary entries on all important terms relating to AEVO.
- Create your own flashcards or tasks.

As a future trainer, you will gain confidence in dealing with all aspects of the training when working on the tasks. The contents of the regulation (basis for the review) or the framework plan are largely reflected. In this respect, the tasks are divided into the four fields of action of the AEVO:

- Check training requirements and plan training,
- prepare training and participate in the recruitment of trainees,
- carry out training,
- Complete training.

Please note that the tasks are not original examination tasks. These will not be published. The legal status is January 1st, 2025.

The terms of use for using the app can be found here.
https://www.dihk-bildungs-gmbh.de/ueber-uns/ihk-aevo-app-trainieren-und-testen

“It’s all a matter of attitude”:
You can decide for yourself how you want to learn via “Settings”. In the test section you can choose between power or sequence mode.

1. Power mode:
In power mode, you repeat questions several times. The more often you answer a question correctly, the less often it will appear. The perfect memory training! No matter how long you study, the algorithm records your learning level based on the probability that a question will be shown again. You can interrupt at any time, switch between fields of action or combine fields of action with one another.

2. Sequence mode:
In sequence mode, you simply work on all questions one after the other. You can have the tasks presented either in a given or random order.

In order to have learning content and your results up to date on all your mobile devices, you can synchronize them by setting up a user account.

Have fun learning with the IHK-AEVO app!

  time doing

Download MINIMAA and start your digital detox today.

—

Accessibility Service API Usage

MINIMAA includes optional features—Focus & Gestures (App & Web Blocking,
navigation shortcuts, and Double Tap to Lock)—that utilize Android's
Accessibility Service API.

When enabled, this service performs the following functions:
• Web Detox & App Blocking: Reads the active application package name and
  browser URL address bar in real-time to detect when a user-defined
  distracting app or website is opened and displays a focus prompt to block
  access.
• Navigation & System Actions: Receives gesture triggers (like double-tapping
  on the home screen or executing motion shortcuts) to perform corresponding
  system actions, such as locking your screen or going Back/Home.

Privacy and Data Safety:
• No Data Collection: The service only reads the active app package name and
  the browser's address bar to determine if a block is triggered. It does not
  record keystrokes, personal details, or other screen content.
• No Data Transmission: No accessed data is stored, collected, or
  transmitted. All processing happens locally on your device.
• Fully Optional: These features are completely optional. The Accessibility
  Service is not enabled by default and can be turned off at any time in
  Android system settings.

MINIMAA is not an accessibility tool for users with disabilities.

name: IHK. 34a GewO
summary: 640 test questions for information according to § 34a GewO available on- or offline
description:
The provider of the app is a non-profit GmbH and not a government institution. All content is based on publicly available information and the requirements of the Security Ordinance (BewachV) in its current version. You can view the current version of the regulation on the following website of the Federal Ministry of Justice: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bewachv_2019/BJNR069200019.html. Despite the greatest care in preparing the questions, no guarantee can be given that the content is correct, complete and up-to-date or that it corresponds to the legal requirements.

Test and train your knowledge with over 640 questions for 40 hours of training in the security industry. This helps you prepare for all security tasks for which no expertise test is required in accordance with Section 34a GewO.

The test questions were developed to support understanding and knowledge in accordance with the Security Ordinance (BewachV) and Section 34a GewO. Please note that these questions are intended as a study aid and are not the official exam questions.

According to the security regulations, the questions are divided into the following subject areas: 
   • Law of public safety and order
   • Commercial law 
   • Data protection 
   • Civil Code 
   • Criminal law and criminal procedure law
   • Handling weapons
   • Accident prevention regulations
   • Dealing with people
   • Basic principles of safety technology

Please note that the questions in this app serve as learning support for instruction in the security industry and are not exam questions for the expertise test according to GewO § 34a. This makes them different from the official exam tasks, which often have a higher level of difficulty. For comprehensive preparation for the knowledge test, we recommend additional courses and specialized learning materials.

When I start the app, I am automatically in training mode, but I can switch to test mode at any time with just a few clicks. In training mode, like with flashcards, I only see the correct answer.  In test mode, I decide on an answer and receive immediate feedback. Alternatively, I can display the correct answer without attempting a solution.

I can decide how I design my test with each test run:
   • I choose questions from just one, several or all subject areas. The orange tick next to the subject areas shows me what has been “actively” selected.
   • I test my knowledge in either power or sequence mode.

Power mode is preset when you start the app. However, I can switch to order mode at any time via Settings.

Power mode: Depending on my test success, the questions are repeated more or less frequently. Questions answered incorrectly appear more often than those answered correctly. The questions are repeated until all have been answered correctly. 

I can influence the probability of resubmission via settings: 
   1. about the “degree of probability” the intervals at which the questions will be presented again 
   2. via the “activation buffer” the number of questions per test run.

Sequence mode: Here I can display the test questions either in a given or random order. I can also set this via settings.
 
What other advantages does the app offer?
   • Display of the current knowledge and processing status either per test run or since the first start of the app.
   • Updating the question pool via “synchronization”
   • Parallel use of the app on all mobile devices I use

We strive to update the question pool regularly to ensure the relevance and accuracy of the content. Please check the app regularly for updates to ensure you have access to the latest information.

description:
Color Block! is a casual block puzzle and brain teaser game built for quick fun and smart thinking. Each level is a compact logic puzzle: slide blocks across the board, sort colors, and find the clean path that clears the space. One bad move can block your progress, so you must plan ahead and use strategy.

The rules are simple. The puzzles are not. Move blocks in tight areas, line up colors, and create openings to finish the level with the best solution. Some stages feel calm and satisfying. Others are real brain teasers that test your focus, timing, and problem solving. If you enjoy puzzles that reward careful planning, you will feel at home here.

In every puzzle, you will:
· Slide blocks to new positions and open routes on the board.
· Match blocks of the same color to remove them and make room.
· Think in steps, not in taps. Set up moves before you commit.
· Beat obstacles like locked tiles, barriers, and limited space.
· Clear the board to unlock the next level and new mechanics.

As you advance, the game adds fresh challenges and clever twists. You will face tighter layouts, tricky blockers, and patterns that require logic and critical thinking. The difficulty grows in a fair way, so you can improve your skills level by level. This is a block puzzle that feels smooth and satisfying, but still makes you think like a puzzle solver.

Every level is designed as a small brain-training exercise. You analyze the board, test a plan, and adjust when the layout changes. The best solutions often come from seeing the puzzle in reverse: where the last match should happen, which block must move first, and how to avoid trapping colors behind barriers. That is the fun of a good brainteaser.

Players come back because you get:
· A true puzzles & brainteasers experience with short, rewarding levels.
· Easy controls and smooth sliding that make every move feel clean.
· A mix of color matching puzzles, sorting puzzles, and sliding puzzles.
· Rewards and achievements for beating hard stages and smart solutions.
· Lots of levels to solve, from simple starters to advanced strategy puzzles.
· Offline play, so you can enjoy the puzzle game anytime, anywhere.
· Bright, clear visuals that help you read the board and plan faster.

If you like logic games, match puzzles, and classic block puzzles, Color Block! gives you a steady stream of challenges. Slide, match, and solve your way through colorful levels, unlock new stages, and see how far your strategy can take you.

summary: Conveyor Loop Color Sort: Every Cube Finds Its Box in a Card Loop Flow
description:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

How to Play Arrow Puzzle:

• In this tap away puzzle game, your goal is to clear the grid—a maze of arrows all pointing in different directions.
• Escape the arrow puzzle grid by finding a free path. An arrow moves only when its way ahead is clear and no other arrows are blocking its path. Take a moment to think first.
• Tap arrows away one by one to help them leave the grid and open up more space for the others. Clean visuals inspired by abstract graphic games help you focus on every move.
• Avoid blocked arrows. If you tap an arrow whose path is blocked, you lose a life. Lives are limited on each level, but you can always rethink your plan and try again at your own pace.
• If you get stuck, use helpful hints to highlight an arrow that can safely escape the maze.
• Plan the order of your taps, help every arrow escape, and master this abstract graphic puzzle game one level at a time.

Why You'll Love Arrow Puzzle:

✔ A minimalist arrow game with simple rules and deep strategy—easy to start, satisfying to master.
✔ Hundreds of handcrafted tap away style puzzles that grow in challenge as you play.
✔ Daily Challenges—play every day, complete monthly challenges, and collect unique trophies.
✔ Helpful hints when you need a small nudge to release an arrow and keep the flow going.
✔ No timer, no pressure—a relaxing escape and a true delight for your mind.
✔ Clean, calming visuals and smooth animations that keep the focus on puzzle-solving in this single-player tap game.

name: Telegram
summary: Telegram is a messaging app with a focus on speed and security.
description:
Pure instant messaging — simple, fast, secure, and synced across all your devices. One of the top 5 most downloaded apps in the world with over 1 billion active users.

FAST: Telegram is the fastest messaging app on the market, connecting people via a unique, distributed network of data centers around the globe.

SYNCED: You can access your messages from all your phones, tablets and computers at once. Telegram apps are standalone, so you don’t need to keep your phone connected. Start typing on one device and finish the message from another. Never lose your data again.

UNLIMITED: You can send media and files, without any limits on their type and size. Your entire chat history will require no disk space on your device, and will be securely stored in the Telegram cloud for as long as you need it. 

SECURE: We made it our mission to provide the best security combined with ease of use. Everything on Telegram, including chats, groups, media, etc. is encrypted using a combination of 256-bit symmetric AES encryption, 2048-bit RSA encryption, and Diffie–Hellman secure key exchange. 

100% FREE & OPEN: Telegram has a fully documented and free API for developers, open source apps and verifiable builds to prove the app you download is built from the exact same source code that is published. 

POWERFUL: You can create group chats with up to 200,000 members, share large videos, documents of any type (.DOCX, .MP3, .ZIP, etc.) up to 2 GB each, and even set up bots for specific tasks. Telegram is the perfect tool for hosting online communities and coordinating teamwork.

RELIABLE: Built to deliver your messages using as little data as possible, Telegram is the most reliable messaging system ever made. It works even on the weakest mobile connections. 

FUN: Telegram has powerful photo and video editing tools, animated stickers and emoji, fully customizable themes to change the appearance of your app, and an open sticker/GIF platform to cater to all your expressive needs.

SIMPLE: While providing an unprecedented array of features, we take great care to keep the interface clean. Telegram is so simple you already know how to use it.

PRIVATE: We take your privacy seriously and will never give any third parties access to your data. You can delete any message you ever sent or received for both sides, at any time and without a trace. Telegram will never use your data to show you ads.

For those interested in maximum privacy, Telegram offers Secret Chats. Secret Chat messages can be programmed to self-destruct automatically from both participating devices. This way you can send all types of disappearing content — messages, photos, videos, and even files. Secret Chats use End-to-End Encryption to ensure that a message can only be read by its intended recipient.

We keep expanding the boundaries of what you can do with a messaging app. Don’t wait years for older messengers to catch up with Telegram — join the revolution today.

name: Pixel Flow!
summary: Pig's Pops!
description:
Conveyor’s ready, pigs are on standby. Tap to send a pig onto the conveyor so it rains balls onto pixel cubes of its own color. The number above its head is its ammo: that’s how many hits it makes. Run out and it leaves the stage; if not, it slips into one of the 5 waiting slots and, when you tap again, it jumps back on the conveyor to fire another round.
The conveyor has a capacity—push past the limit and you’ll need to wait. Send them in the right order, manage the flow, and hit the cubes to clear the board piece by piece. Simple mechanic, sticky loop: tap → flow → repeat.
Highlights
One-tap control: Quick sessions, easy one-handed play.
Color matching: Pigs only hit their own color—no target-picking hassle.
Conveyor capacity: Timing and queue management add a bite-size strategy layer.
5 waiting slots: Stack, sort, and launch at the perfect moment.
Short but “one more round” feel: Perfect for micro-breaks.
Satisfying pixel cleanup: Every hit leaves the board feeling crisp.
For anyone who loves fast action-puzzles, timing, and flow management. The pigs are ready. The cubes… not so much.

name: Rise of Kingdoms: Lost Crusade
summary: The journey of your civilization starts here.
description:
Shape Your Civilization with 180,000,000+ Players Worldwide!
What if ancient China and ancient Rome went to war? When Julius Caesar clashes with Cao Cao on the same battlefield, who shall emerge victorious?
What does it feel like to play a war strategy game that fuses MOBA and RTS mechanics, featuring multiplayer competition and real-time combat?
What stories will unfold in a vast world shared by over 80,000 players, free to explore, gather, create, build, and battle?
Find the answer in Rise of Kingdoms, a battlefield unlike anything you have experienced before.

▶FEATURES◀
15 Unique Civilizations
Choose one of 15 historical civilizations and guide your empire from a lone clan into a great, unstoppable force! Each civilization has its own architecture, unique units, and special advantages — how you utilize them is up to you!

Real-Time Battles
Battles happen in real time on the map. Anyone can join or leave a battle at any time, allowing true RTS gameplay. See an ally being attacked right in your backyard? Send some troops to help your buddy out, or launch a surprise counterattack on the attacker’s city.

Seamless World Map
All in-game action takes place on a single, enormous map inhabited by players and NPCs. No isolated bases or separate battle screens. Never before seen on mobile “infinite zoom” allows you to transition freely between the world view and individual cities or barbarian outposts. Map features include natural obstructions such as rivers and mountain ranges and strategic passes that must be captured to gain entrance to neighboring regions.

Exploration & Investigation
Your world is covered in thick fog. Dispatch scouts to explore this mysterious land and uncover the hidden treasure within.
Investigate lost temples, barbarian fortresses, mysterious caves, and tribal villages, gather intelligence on your enemies, and prepare yourself for the ultimate battle!

Unrestricted Troop Movements
New orders can be issued to troops at any time, offering limitless strategic possibilities. Launch an attack on an enemy city, then circle back and meet up with your alliance army to capture a pass.
Dispatch troops to collect lumber from a nearby forest and have them pick off a few barbarian clans along the way. Forces can also be split up between multiple commanders so that you can engage in multiple actions simultaneously.

Alliance System
Full alliance features allow players to help one another: live chat with built-in translation, officer roles, map indicators to coordinate strategies, and more! Alliances can expand their territory to gain resources, capture mountain passes and barbarian outposts to strengthen their position, and work together to unlock group achievements.

Conquer the Kingdom
Fight alongside your alliance to take control of this vast kingdom. Clash with other players and use superior tactics to emerge victorious in a MMO strategy battle royale. Rise to the top and you and your civilization will be written down in your kingdom’s history!

RPG Commanders
Call upon dozens of historical figures who will serve as your trustworthy commanders, from Julius Caesar and Sun Tzu to Joan of Arc and Kusunoki Masashige. Level up your commanders by defeating barbarians and sending them into battles, then upgrade their abilities using an RPG style talent tree and skill system.

name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

Play your way

• Chain-hook combat built around pulling enemies into range
• Devour power and turn every hunt into permanent growth
• Upgrade damage, speed, armor, and health
• Collect gear and customize your loadout
• Fight monsters, aliens, elite enemies, and giant bosses
• Climb the Boss Tower and complete quests
• Earn crystals, open chests, and improve the Soul Graph

Start small, hunt smarter, and become the hero no monster can stop. Hook the enemy, steal its power, upgrade your build, and turn every fight into permanent growth.

name: Jelly Busters: Puzzle Game

description:
Drop into the smoothest skatepark in town with the Jelly Busters crew, a squad of bouncy jellies who live to skate, color shoot, and bust their way through walls of cubes. Every run starts with a simple push on your board, a quick aim, and a clean shot as you send your jelly flying into a glowing, colorful puzzle blast of cubes hiding a secret picture and image below.

Jelly Busters adds a fun, skate-infused twist packed with ASMR pleasure and arcade-style thrills. With every tap, you shoot into stacks of colors, bust the cubes, and slowly keep busting the image underneath until the whole board is clear.

The sound and feel are tuned for maximum satisfying chill. Cubes crumble with soft pops, jellies bounce just right, and the whole game wraps you in a relaxing mood that still demands fast reaction and strategic thinking. It’s the perfect combination: a cube shooter that’s as soothing as it is intense, always very satisfying to clear the image at the end of a run.

But the park has tricks of its own. From the very first levels, you’ll see that this isn’t just mindless tapping. The game develops and gets more challenging and harder as you play, with clever layouts and sneaky blockers that force you to plan ahead. Each new level adds a fresh twist - more cubes, tougher patterns, and smarter obstacles that you’ll have to avoid if you want to keep your blast streak going.

To keep things interesting, you’ll unlock powerful level boosters that turn tight spots into epic comebacks. Trigger a massive blast, shatter whole sections at once, or set off chain reactions that leave nothing behind. As you progress, you’ll constantly win rewards and win prizes, giving your jelly crew more ways to dominate the skatepark and tackle the trickiest levels.

Get ready to compete with players everywhere, pushing your skills to the limit as you advance in leaderboards. When you finally join the leaderboard of top busters, every clean run and every perfectly cleared board will feel even sweeter.

Jelly Busters is your new go-to for relaxing ASMR cube action: a wildly exciting and deeply satisfying skatepark adventure filled with jellies, cubes, vibrant colors, puzzle challenges, explosive blast moments, and endless chances to win rewards and prizes while riding along with the coolest jelly crew around.

In Jelly Busters, every shot is a chance to burst through, and every completed picture feels like a tiny victory. So grab your (skate) board, team up with the jellies, and start busting cubes to enjoy a relaxing yet satisfying yet totally exciting image puzzle blast. 

Download Jelly Busters today and unleash the sweet, strategic chaos of this awesome jelly adventure.

♣  CHOOSE FROM THREE DIFFERENT CARD DESIGNS: German, French or Tournament card deck
♣  PLAY WITH TOURNAMENT- OR CASUAL RULES: both variants have their charms - just try them out
♣  FLAUNT YOUR SKILLS IN THE LEAGUE: rise up the ranks in our leagues and become a champion
♣  SUPPORT: our intuitive and easy to navigate app, various help sites and a great customer support will facilitate your journey to becoming a Skat master!

If you are a fan of other card games like Doppelkopf, Rummy or Solitaire then you will love Skat! Our game is and will remain entirely free to play, you may however benefit from in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay experience!

The Rapture invasion came without warning. It was both ruthless and overwhelming.
The reason: unknown. No room for negotiations.
In what seemed like an instant, the earth was turned into a sea of fire. Countless humans were hunted down and slaughtered without mercy.
None of mankind's modern technology stood a chance against this colossal invasion.

name: Rogue Legend - Roguelike RPG
summary: Action roguelike RPG with upgrades, boss fights, and idle progression!
description:
Embark on an action roguelike RPG adventure with Rogue Legend, where every battle makes your hero stronger.
In Rogue Legend, you journey through worlds filled with monsters, treasures, and powerful bosses. Each run is a new roguelike RPG experience of strategy, combat, and growth, giving you the chance to strengthen your hero and push further with every run.

Enter a World of Endless Battles:
Every session begins in the lobby. Press Play and roll the dice to start your roguelike RPG run, diving into a board-based action RPG full of encounters and surprises. As your hero moves across the board, different events unfold depending on where you land:
* Enemy Tiles: Engage in fast, automatic roguelike RPG battles. After each fight, choose one of three upgrades to shape your build.
* Buff Tiles: Gain boosts to attack, defense, and speed to help your hero survive longer in Rogue Legend’s idle-friendly dungeons.
* Negative Tiles: Face debuffs that test your timing and strategic decisions.
* Minigame Tiles: Roll for luck in short events where you can win extra loot or power-ups.
* Shop Tiles: Spend gold to buy new gear, upgrades, and legendary equipment.
* Special Tiles: Additional tile types will be added over time to expand Rogue Legend’s gameplay depth.

Defeat Bosses and Grow Stronger:
Your goal is to survive, adapt, and conquer every boss battle. Each fight is an opportunity to grow stronger, unlocking new roguelike RPG challenges, rewards, and abilities that prepare your hero for the next run in this idle RPG adventure.

Upgrade, Progress, and Customize Your Hero:
Between runs, return to the lobby to enhance your hero through Rogue Legend’s RPG progression systems:
* Gear System: Collect and upgrade your weapons, armor, and equipment. Collect S weapons!
* Talent System: Level up to unlock new stats, passive abilities, and bonuses that fit your playstyle.
* Pet System: Obtain and train pets that join you in combat.
* Hero Collection: Collect more heroes to unlock new strategies, then level and ascend them to raise their base power. Swap heroes to match different boards, enemies, and builds.
* Mounts: Equip & ride mounts that grant powerful stat bonuses and combat perks
* …and more progression systems to discover as you climb!


Roguelike Depth with Idle RPG Progression
Rogue Legend blends the excitement of roguelike gameplay with the satisfaction of RPG and idle progression. Each run feels fast, rewarding, and different. The board and dice mechanics make every move matter, while the idle RPG design ensures steady progress without repetitive grind.

A Journey of Strategy and Power:
If you enjoy roguelike action, RPG adventure, and idle gameplay, Rogue Legend delivers a journey of endless replayability.
⚔️ Fight, roll, and rise again in Rogue Legend, the roguelike idle RPG where every battle shapes your hero’s fate.

name: Microsoft Authenticator
summary: No more passwords, easier sign-in, and greater protection for your accounts.
description:
Use Microsoft Authenticator for easy, secure sign-ins for all your online accounts using multi-factor authentication or passwordless. You also have additional account management options for your Microsoft personal, work or school accounts.

Getting started with multi-factor authentication

Multi factor authentication (MFA) or two factor authentication (2FA) provides a second layer of security. When logging in with multi-factor authentication, you’ll enter your password, and then you’ll be asked for an additional way to prove it’s really you. Either approve the notification sent to the Microsoft Authenticator, or enter the one-time password (OTP) generated by the app. The one-time passwords (OTP codes) have a 30 second timer counting down. This timer is so you never have to use the same time-based one-time password (TOTP) twice and you don’t have to remember the number. The one-time password (OTP) doesn’t require you to be connected to a network, and it won’t drain your battery. You can add multiple accounts to your app, including non-Microsoft accounts like Facebook, Amazon, Dropbox, Google, LinkedIn, GitHub, and more.

Getting started with passwordless

Use your phone, not your password, to log into your Microsoft account. Just enter your username, then approve the notification sent to your phone. Your fingerprint, face ID, or PIN will provide a second layer of security in this two-step verification process. After you’ve signed in with two factor authentication (2FA), you’ll have access to all your Microsoft products and services, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Office, and more.

Microsoft personal, work or school accounts

Sometimes your work or school might ask you to install the Microsoft Authenticator when accessing certain files, emails, or apps. You will need to register your device to your organization through the app and add your work or school account. Microsoft Authenticator also supports cert-based authentication by issuing a certificate on your device. This will let your organization know that the sign-in request is coming from a trusted device and help you seamlessly and securely access additional Microsoft apps and services without needing to log into each. Because Microsoft Authenticator supports single sign-on, once you have proven your identity once, you will not need to log in again to other Microsoft apps on your device.

Optional Access Permissions

Microsoft Authenticator includes the following optional access permissions. All these require user consent. If you choose to not grant these optional access permissions, you can still use Microsoft Authenticator for other services that do not require such permission. For more information see https://aka.ms/authappfaq

Location: Sometimes your organization wants to know your location before allowing you to access certain resources. The app will request this permission only if your organization has a policy requiring location.

Camera: Used to scan QR codes when you add a work, school, or non-Microsoft account.

Read the contents of your storage: This permission is only used when you report a technical problem through the app settings. Some information from your storage is collected to diagnose the issue.

* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

Now those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!

Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. 

Ninja Kiwi Community:
We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative, at https://support.ninjakiwi.com.

Streamers and Video Creators: 
Ninja Kiwi is actively promoting channel creators on YouTube and Twitch! If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and tell us about your channel at streamers@ninjakiwi.com.

name: The Room
summary: The definitive puzzle experience
description:
Welcome to The Room, a physical puzzler, wrapped in a mystery game, inside a beautifully tactile 3D world.

*****************

How are you, old friend? If you’re reading this, then it worked. I only hope you can still forgive me. 

We’ve never seen eye to eye on my research, but you must put such things behind you. You are the only one to whom I can turn. You must come at once, for we are all in great peril. I trust you remember the house? My study is the highest room. 

Press forward with heart. There is no way back now. 

AS. 

****** 
Fireproof Games are very proud to bring you our greatest creation, a mind-bending journey filled with beauty, peril and mystery in equal measure. Be transported into a unique space that blends spellbinding visuals with intriguing problems to solve.

• Unsettlingly realistic graphics: Vibrant natural-looking visuals perfected for mobile displays.
• Spine-tingling single finger controls: touch controls so natural you can play with one digit, to fully navigate this mysteriously beautiful 3D world.
• Fantastical pick-up-and-play design: Easy to start, hard to put down, the secrets of The Room will immerse you before you even know you're playing.
• Compelling layers of mystery: think you know what you're looking at? Think again.

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Stardew Valley
summary: The smash hit farming RPG now on mobile!
description:
Stardew Valley comes to Mobile!

Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**
**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**

---

BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:

■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm

■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way

■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from

■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates

■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests

■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure

■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside

■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal

■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on Android with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines

■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...

■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen, virtual joystick, and external controller support.

---

"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN

“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb

“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine

---

Note: Features 1.4 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.

name: Saints Row: The Third
summary: Outrageous open-world action in the palm of your hand.
description:
From scrappy street gang to their own energy drinks, clothing lines and international brand recognition, The Third Street Saints have come a long way. Now their sights are set on Steelport: a once-proud metropolis brought low by a trifecta of gangs known as the Syndicate.

Tailored to touchscreen and optimised for Android, Saints Row: The Third Remastered is an open world of shameless excess in the palm of your hand.

YOUR CITY, YOUR RULES
Tear up the streets with tanks and hover bikes, build a portfolio of cribs and “legit” businesses, and take Steelport from the Syndicate district-by-district.

CRUSH THE COMPETITION
Win the arms race against the gun-running Morningstar, lay the smackdown on the Luchadores, and delete the Decker cyber-criminals across 47 madcap missions.

ACTION ON EVERY CORNER
Earn cash and respect by base-jumping, boosting cars, and becoming a gravity-defying insurance fraudster.

WEAPONS OF CRASS DESTRUCTION
Defeating your enemies is good. Humiliating them is so much better! Beat rivals into submission with outrageous weapons, and reinvent the drive-by with human cannonball cars and flamethrowing Genkimobiles.

IT’S IN YOUR HANDS!
The full AAA experience on the go, with customisable touchscreen controls, plus support for gamepads and mouse & keyboard.

OVER-THE-TOP CO-OP
Steelport is even more fun with homies – play the entire game online with a friend.

THE FULL PACKAGE
Saints Row: The Third Remastered comes complete with all its DLC, from Professor Genki’s murderous Genkibowl VII, sci-fi stardom in Gangstas in Space, and even weirder science in The Trouble With Clones. Also in the mix are over 30 more weapons, vehicles, and costumes.

===

Supported Languages: English, Čeština, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, Nederlands, Polski, Русский

Saints Row: The Third Remastered requires Android 13 or later. You need 19.3GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.

To avoid disappointment, we aim to block users from purchasing a game if their device is not capable of running it. If you are able to purchase this game on your device then we expect it to run well in most cases.

However, we are aware of rare instances where users are able to purchase the game on unsupported devices. This can occur when a device is not correctly identified by the Google Play Store, and therefore cannot be blocked from purchasing. For full details on the supported chipsets for this game, plus a list of tested and verified devices, we recommend that you visit:

https://feral.in/saintsrow3-android-devices

name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
summary: Season the Seas
description:
ONE PIECE comes to life as a restaurant management sim game!

As a new staff member, work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to turn the second location of the renowned Baratie floating restaurant into the greatest restaurant of the seas!

-Dish Out a Signature Menu
Get inspired by characters' ideas, choose your ingredients, and work with Sanji to cook delicious dishes. Arrange them into unique meal sets by adding different flourishes, then adventure to find even more recipes! From iconic series favorites like Water-Water Meat BBQ and Sea King Penne Gorgonzola to special creations that harness the powers of Devil Fruits, a treasure trove of dishes awaits.

-Design A Tasteful Interior
Choose from over 200 furniture, building, and decorative items to make your restaurant uniquely yours! From dessert-themed Whole Cake Island pieces to futuristic Egghead items, the customization options are as vast as the sea. If a character likes your design, they may even become a regular!

-Table for 400
From the Straw Hat Crew and beyond, over 400 ONE PIECE characters appear as staff and customers in a spritely pixel style for the first time in a game! With so many characters, you'll experience character events and special character interactions that can’t be found anywhere else.

name: The Room: Old Sins
summary: The 4th entry in the multi-award winning ‘The Room’ puzzle game series
description:
Enter The Room: Old Sins and be transported to a place where tactile exploration meets challenging puzzles and a captivating story. 
The sudden disappearance of an ambitious engineer and his high-society wife provokes the hunt for a precious artefact. The trail leads to the attic of their home, and the discovery of an old, peculiar dollhouse…
Explore unsettling locations, follow obscure clues and manipulate bizarre contraptions as you uncover the mysteries within Waldegrave Manor.

THE ULTIMATE PUZZLE BOX
Explore a deviously complex dollhouse which transforms at your fingertips. Each intricate room is a portal to a new, stunning environment. 
 
PICK-UP-AND-PLAY DESIGN
Easy to begin yet hard to put down, enjoy a unique mix of intriguing puzzles with a simple user interface. 

INTUITIVE TOUCH CONTROLS
A tactile experience so natural you can almost feel the surface of each object. 

INTRICATE OBJECTS
Examine dozens of detailed objects to discover which of them conceal hidden mechanisms. 

ATMOSPHERIC AUDIO
A haunting soundtrack coupled with dynamic sound effects create an unforgettable soundscape. 

CLOUD SAVE SUPPORTED
Share your progress between multiple devices and unlock achievements. 

MULTI LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Russian.


Fireproof Games is an independent studio from Guildford, United Kingdom.
Find out more at fireproofgames.com
Follow us @Fireproof_Games
Find us on Facebook

name: MONOPOLY
summary: Roll the dice, pass go and win! Play Hasbro's official MONOPOLY mobile game.
description:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

The MONOPOLY name and logo, the distinctive design of the gameboard, the four corner squares, the MR. MONOPOLY name and character, as well as each of the distinctive elements of the board and playing pieces are trademarks of Hasbro for its property trading game and game equipment. © 1935, 2025 Hasbro. All Rights Reserved.

name: Brotato: Premium
summary: 🥔 Survive the alien horde! Equip 6 weapons at once in this roguelite shooter.
description:
Blast through alien hordes as Brotato, the only potato capable of wielding 6 weapons simultaneously! 

You are the last hope on a hostile planet. Stranded and outnumbered, you must battle relentless waves of aliens, scavenge materials, and craft unique builds to survive until rescue arrives. Can you hold out against the endless swarm?

Each run lasts just 20–30 minutes, delivering thrilling, fast-paced roguelite action perfect for quick mobile sessions. Build your strategy with dozens of traits and hundreds of items—and see how far you can survive!

【KEY FEATURES】
⚔️ SIX-WEAPON FRENZY: Wield up to 6 weapons at once with default auto-firing or precision manual aiming.
⏱️ FAST-PACED ACTION: Quick, intense runs designed to be completed in under 30 minutes.
🎭 DIVERSE CHARACTERS: Choose from a wide range of traits—from One-Armed and Crazy to Lucky and Mage—to create your unique build.
🛠️ INFINITE BUILDS: Experiment with hundreds of items and weapons, including flamethrowers, SMGs, rocket launchers, and even sticks & stones!
🌊 SURVIVAL WAVES: Survive 20 to 90-second waves and collect materials to level up and gear up in the shop.

⚠️ NOTE: Cloud saving is available only while online. You can play offline, but your progress will not be synced to the cloud without an internet connection.

【STAY CONNECTED】
📺 YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtaSitbjWjhnlzuX2ZLjtUg
💬 Discord: @Erabit or join via https://discord.gg/P6vekfhc46
🐦 Twitter: @erabit_studios
🎵 TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@brotato_mobile
📘 Facebook: @Brotato (facebook.com/brotatomobile)
📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/brotato_mobile/
🌐 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/brotato_mobile/

【SUPPORT】
📧 Any in-game issues, please contact: support@erabitstudios.com

name: Ticket to Ride®
summary: The iconic train game arrives on mobile! Play against AI or online multiplayer.
description:
🚂🗺️ Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 

Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 

Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 

Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!

Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 

Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!


HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:
1. Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
2. Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
3. Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
4. When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 


FEATURES
- A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
- PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
- SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
- AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
- STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.

Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

name: The Room Three
summary: A journey of discovery awaits
description:
“Probably the Best Mobile Game of 2015” - Vice

“With its rich atmosphere and clever puzzles, The Room Three is engrossing and hard to put down.” - Game Informer

“A triumph. We fully recommend immersing yourself in this atmospheric mystery” - Stuff

“Much bigger and longer than the previous titles, more of a full-blown adventure game” - Touch Arcade

“A brilliant, uniquely tactile experience packed with incredible puzzles. Just go and buy it.” - Pocket Gamer

___________________________________________________________________________________

The eagerly awaited sequel to the BAFTA award winning 'The Room' and 'The Room Two' is finally here.

Welcome to The Room Three, a physical puzzle game within a beautifully tactile world.
Lured to a remote island, you must draw upon all your puzzle-solving ability to navigate a series of trials devised by a mysterious figure known only as “The Craftsman”.


PICK-UP-AND-PLAY DESIGN
Easy to begin yet hard to put down, enjoy a unique mix of intriguing puzzles with a simple user interface.

INTUITIVE TOUCH CONTROLS
A tactile experience so natural you can almost feel the surface of each object.

EXPANDED LOCATIONS
Lose yourself in a variety of stunning new environments, each spanning multiple areas.

INTRICATE OBJECTS
Rotate, zoom and examine dozens of artifacts to discover their hidden secrets.

ATMOSPHERIC AUDIO
A haunting soundtrack coupled with dynamic sound effects create an unforgettable soundscape.

MAGNIFIED WORLDS
Use the new eyepiece ability to explore the world in miniature

ALTERNATE ENDINGS
Return to a persistent environment and change your fate

ENHANCED HINT SYSTEM
Re-read hints to get the full picture

CLOUD SAVING SUPPORTED
Share your progress between multiple devices, and unlock the all-new achievements. 

MULTI LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish and Russian.



Fireproof Games is an independent studio from Guildford, United Kingdom.
Find out more at fireproofgames.com
Follow us @Fireproof_Games
Find us on Facebook

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
summary: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
summary: Epic fantasy tower defense, return to Linirea and rewrite the kingdom's past
description:
Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis, the latest chapter in the legendary tower defense saga. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, command epic heroes, and stop a young Vez'nan before the kingdom falls, on a battlefield where every tower placement matters.

Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of goblins, orcs, and worse across the original Kingdom Rush lands. Offline. Pure tower defense.
History is broken. The Kingdom has fallen. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past.

A PREQUEL WITH STAKES
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and uncover the moment that turned a young mage into the saga's greatest villain.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them.  Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break. Classic tower defense, refined.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: CloverPit
summary: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a debt simulator!
description:
Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.

P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

name: Slay the Spire
summary: Deckbuilding Dungeon Crawl
description:
We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

Features
- Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top.
- An Ever-changing Spire: Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses!
- Powerful Relics to Discover: Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold.

name: Thronefall
summary: A strategy game without all the headache? We got you covered!
description:
Thronefall - a critically acclaimed and award winning PC game! Metacritics: 92%. Steam: Overwhelmingly Positive, 96%.

Saddle the horses! See your kingdom come to life, fight gripping battles to defend it and still be done in time for lunch.

With Thronefall we tried to strip a classic strategy game from all unnecessary complexity, combining it with a healthy amount of hack and slay. Build up your base during the day, defend it til your last breath at night. 

Will you be able to strike the right balance between economy and defense? Do you need more archers, thicker walls or an additional mill? Will you keep the enemies at bay with your longbow or charge your horse right into them? It's going to be a tough night, but nothing beats seeing the sun rise above your little kingdom to live another day.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
summary: Fly around the world! Pilot 3D airplanes and land at airports in this live sim!
description:
Your Ultimate Flight Simulation Experience on Mobile! Discover the thrill of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator, the most advanced flight simulation for mobile.

Whether you are a pro pilot or starting your journey into airplane games, RFS offers the most comprehensive experience. Pilot iconic aircraft, access global flights in real time, and explore ultra-realistic airports with live weather. This is the ultimate simulator for fans of plane games and flight simulation games.

Fly Anywhere in the World!
Take off from any part of the globe. Our flight simulator uses high-res satellite maps and 3D plane models to create a living world. Experience the unique sensation of being an airplane pilot as you navigate realistic topography. Fly through the world and explore detailed landmarks in your favorite 3D airplane.

60+ Aircraft Models – Take control of commercial, cargo, and military jets. From narrow-body airliners to massive jumbo planes, each aircraft features 3D live cockpits, FMC, and realistic lighting. New airplanes and planes are added regularly to our fleet!

1900+ HD Airports – Land your plane at detailed 3D airports with jetways and authentic taxiway procedures. Navigate busy terminals like a real pilot. Ground services include pushback, refueling, and catering for a complete airline experience.

Realistic Satellite Terrain – Fly over high-fidelity landscapes. Our technology provides accurate elevation data for every mountain and valley. Experience the most advanced landing simulator on mobile. Perfect for fans of realistic flight simulator gameplay.

Autopilot & Advanced Planning – Plan long-haul flights with precise autopilot, VNAV, LNAV, and ILS landing assistance. Customize weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots and explore the global aviation network.

Real Pilot Checklists – Master every stage of the flight. Follow authentic takeoff and landing procedures for total immersion in your pilot simulator. Use real-world protocols for every flight and plane mission.

Live Global Flights – Experience the world in real-time! Track over 40,000 real-time flights daily at major hubs world-wide. See live air traffic and join a living global flight network.

Join a Global Aviation Community!
RFS is more than just a flight game; it’s a living community.

• Fly with hundreds of aviators in real-time multiplayer modes.
• Chat with fellow pilots in the cockpit or global frequency.
• Join a Virtual Airline (VA) and compete in the leaderboards.

ATC Mode: Take Control of the Skies!
Become an Air Traffic Controller! 

• Manage live air traffic in our dedicated ATC game mode.
• Issue instructions, guide planes to the runway, and ensure safe navigation.
• Experience high-fidelity multi-voice ATC communications.

Create and Share Your Passion!

• Customize Your Plane: Design custom airplane liveries and share them globally.
• Design Your Airport: Build your own HD airport and watch the community take off.
• Plane Spotter Mode: Capture 3D screenshots and share with airplane game fans.
• Dynamic Environment: Experience stunning sunrise and sunsets in highest fidelity.

Technical Sim Features:

• Multi-panel instruments for advanced avionics.
• Realistic 3D spatial audio and real-time weather.
• Complex failure simulation including engines and gear.
• Weight and balance for realistic flight physics.

An Internet connection is required for real-time simulation and multiplayer.
Some features and airplanes require a subscription.

Get Ready to Soar!
Buckle up, push the throttle, and become a Real Pilot in RFS!

Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: Dice A Million
summary: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice?
description:
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.

Will you be able to push luck to your side?

name: The Room Two
summary: A time-spanning journey
description:
Welcome to The Room Two, a physical puzzler, wrapped in a mystery game, inside a beautifully tactile 3D world. 
The much anticipated sequel to ‘The Room’, recipient of a BAFTA award, is here at last. 

Follow a trail of cryptic letters from an enigmatic scientist known only as "AS" into a compelling world of mystery and exploration. 

*******************************************************************************************************************

“An incredibly compelling experience with clever puzzles, gorgeous visuals, and a spooky atmosphere; absolutely brimming with new ideas.” – The Verge 

“An intricately woven work of fiction perfectly suited to its format, this is the sort of game that it's worth sitting in the dark for.” - Pocketgamer 

“A gorgeous-looking game offering larger locations with multiple interactive areas and puzzles. A perfect game for a cold winter's night.” – Eurogamer 

“Leaves you thinking about how to solve its puzzles even when not playing; a sign of a classy game, which this most definitely is.” – 148Apps 

“A superb sequel with stunning visuals, the level of complexity on display here is quite astounding. The Room Two should be on top of your gaming list.” - GSM Arena 


*******************************************************************************************************************

PICK-UP-AND-PLAY DESIGN 
Easy to start, hard to put down, an entrancing mix of intriguing puzzles with a simple user interface 

INNOVATIVE TOUCH CONTROLS 
A tactile experience so natural you can almost feel the surface of each object 

REALISTIC 3D LOCATIONS 
Immerse yourself in a variety of stunning environments which will challenge your puzzle solving prowess. 

DETAILED 3D OBJECTS 
Pore over the intricate details of dozens of artifacts in search of their hidden secrets. 

UNNERVING AUDIO 
A haunting soundtrack and dynamic sound effects create a soundscape that reacts to your play. 

CLOUD SAVING NOW SUPPORTED
